en.p: There is a function defined on the closed interval $[0,\,2\pi]$:

For real numbers $t$ with $0\le t\le 2\pi$, the sum of all values of $t$ for which the equation $f(x)=f(t)$ in $x$ has exactly 3 distinct real roots is $\dfrac{q}{p}\pi$. Find the value of $p+q$. (Here $p$ and $q$ are relatively prime natural numbers.) [4 points]
